basics.name: Starlett Olivas
basics.label: Professional Caregiver & Patient Care Specialist
basics.summary: Dedicated, compassionate, and safety-certified Caregiver & Patient Care Specialist with over 5 years of combined experience in direct patient care, high-pressure operations, and behavioral health studies. Proven track record of delivering dignified assistance with Activities of Daily Living (ADLs), medication adherence monitoring, and vital sign observation while maintaining strict HIPAA confidentiality.

work.name: Visiting Angels / Private Home Care
highlights: Delivered 1-on-1 compassionate care and emotional support to elderly and vulnerable clients, assisting with essential Activities of Daily Living (ADLs).
Managed medication schedules and ensured strict adherence to prescribed care plans in coordination with family members and primary healthcare providers.
Maintained detailed daily care logs documenting client vitals, behavioral changes, nutritional intake, and physical mobility.
Employed active listening and non-violent de-escalation techniques during moments of client agitation, confusion, or distress.
Upheld 100% compliance with HIPAA regulations and client privacy protocols within home and facility settings.

work.name: UPS (United Parcel Service)
highlights: Executed high-volume, physical daily operations in a fast-paced environment under strict time constraints.
Maintained an exemplary attendance and punctuality record, demonstrating unwavering reliability and stamina.
Applied rigorous safety standards and asset accountability protocols to prevent workplace injury and inventory loss.
